//: Scoped TS config for Vercel Functions (the api/ directory). The root tsconfig.json targets the Vite app and uses moduleResolution:bundler + allowImportingTsExtensions, which is right for Vite but wrong for @vercel/node — that compiles each api/*.ts file as a Node-ESM serverless function, and Node ESM requires real .js relative imports. NodeNext gives us that behaviour: tsc resolves .ts at compile time but the emitted JS keeps the .js path the source typed.
